---
description: "Plan a small pilot for a recurring project review."
---

Apply **Project assessment** in the
[Microsoft IQ Navigator instructions](../agents/microsoft-iq-navigator.agent.md)
to plan a weekly review. Map decisions and owners, approved KPIs, escalation
rules, and public vendor changes to their respective sources. Pick at most two
IQ capabilities for the pilot and say what to defer. Keep the Recommendation
column about IQ fit and state **Pilot readiness** separately. Give an
observable success check and, where access or freshness matters, a
failure-path check. Do not fetch records or send the brief.
